answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 9660 Country: India Title: Can we made a qabar of the house member according to his 'Wasiyat" in side of the house? Whenever other house members are residing in the house still now? Question: Can we made a qabar of the house member according to his 'Wasiyat" in side of the house? Whenever other house members are residing in the house still now? Answer ID: 9660 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2283/2078=D/1429) It is prohibited to make grave in house, even if anyone has passed a will, his will is against Shariah which should not be fulfilled: لاطاقة لمخلوق فى معصية االخالق Burial in the house is characteristic of the Prophets ( علیھم السلام ) . Others are prohibited to bury their dead in house. كما نقل الشامي عن فتح القدير: ولا يدفن صغير ولا كبير في البيت الذي مات فيه, فإن ذلك خاص بالأنبياء, بل ينقل إلى مقابر المسلمين (شامى 660/1) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
